noise_band.rule: candidate record not worse than the baseline record by more than 1 win(s) on a 70-map pool (tolerance = ceil(70 * 1/70) = 1; measured: three different binaries all recorded 58-12 on the 70-map pool)
noise_band.derivation: measured: three different binaries all recorded 58-12 on the 70-map pool, so binary-change noise on the RECORD is <= 1 win per 70 maps; tolerance = ceil(pool_size * 1/70)
